articles.summary: Canterbury Park has submitted a request to the Minnesota Racing Commission for a 51-day thoroughbred and quarter horse season that would run from Saturday, May 22 through Saturday, Sept. 25. The 2027 calendar offers the same number of race days as 2026 however the meet has been extended by one week to better accommodate the […]
articles.title: Canterbury Park Seeks Racing Commission Approval for 51 Race Dates in 2027; Meet would run May 22 to Sept. 25
